dtype: E4M3 FP8 operands, pow2 block scales, FP32 GEMM accumulation, BF16 dW; BF16 control
method: Unprofiled median of per-step maximum rank wall time. Each formal run primes the full workload, runs 10 warmups and 30 samples. Identical input/routing hashes within each comparison. Weights are prepared once outside timing. BWD-only prepares a fresh forward tape outside timing. Wall includes gradient cleanup; backward-ready ends with live gradients. These are not pure kernel durations.

experiments.release_x: Release operands after dY column stores, before waiting/converting X.
experiments.release_load: Read dY+scales into registers, release operands before column quantization.
experiments.release_promote: Additionally release non-cache-owner operands after final WGMMA wait, before promotion.
experiments.early: release-load plus per-expert dW queue after each cluster retires its own dgrad/Pull; single-node only.
experiments.registers: Baseline plus local BWD math/control budgets 208/88, 224/56 or 232/40, versus 216/72.
experiments.status: Archived outside production sources. selected denotes the historical 224/232 experiment, not the current fixed policy.

limitations: No multi-node or training convergence validation in this experiment.
Readiness printf is diagnostic only and perturbs dW; its timings are excluded from speed comparisons.
CTA arrival spread is not the whole global-barrier cost; only within-rank timestamp differences are used.
Near-parity results do not establish a stable speedup. Native builds and variant processes are separate.

An earlier final-cycle run overlapped CPU-only disassembly and is excluded from the final table; retained separately at build/fp8-stage-opt/final-cycle-with-host-inspection. The reported final-cycle rerun had no concurrent build, profiler or disassembly.

historical_decision.retained: Separate local BWD register partition: Qwen35B/Qwen122B 224 math + 56 control; Flash 232 + 40. FWD and network BWD retain their existing partitions.
historical_decision.rejected: All three early operand-release candidates lack a consistent gain; per-expert early dW adds queue/register costs and regresses. Their code exists only as experiment patches.
historical_decision.numerical_behavior: No quantization, scale, accumulation order or AB/checkpoint policy changes.
historical_decision.scope: Final full-cycle results are measured on a clean rebuild of the retained source. BWD budget gains are from the preceding register scan; all candidates and final builds passed EP8 correctness.
historical_decision.goal_status: Qwen35B full-cycle is near BF16 parity; its 8K median is slightly slower. Qwen122B and Flash full-cycle medians beat BF16. Separate BWD remains slower than BF16 for Qwen35B and Qwen122B 8K. The stronger per-phase goal is not met.

decision.status: active fixed policy; timing records below describe historical variants
decision.scope: Shared FP8 constants used by forward and backward across all model profiles.
decision.reason: User explicitly selected 224/56. Remove model-specific partitions, register configuration macros and register autotuning entry points.
decision.validation: All three model profiles rebuilt and passed single-node EP8 forward/backward correctness, including skewed routes, an empty rank, reverse asynchronous multi-version backward, checkpoint, optimizer and inference checks.

fixed_register_validation.timing_scope: No new performance run or autotuning. Historical selected-variant timings do not measure this fixed policy, which applies 224/56 to FP8 forward as well as backward.
